notes: Fixes a Vault that belonged to one device instead of to you. A chat you put in the Vault was hidden on all your devices, but listed only on the one you added it from — so everywhere else it was reachable from neither list. The Vault now belongs to your account: the same code opens it on every device and shows the same chats. Nothing was lost in the meantime; the chats are there as soon as you open the Vault with your code. Opening the Vault on a device that still held a chat's key now clears that copy too, which is what the Vault was always meant to do. Setting up a Vault also refuses, now, when the app cannot check whether your account already has one — creating a second would have stranded everything in the first.
